questions.question: When a murdered man was found in a field and nobody knew the killer, whose elders had to take a heifer?

answers.text: The largest town in the land
The town where the man lived

questions.question: Moses said an Israelite who no longer wanted his captive wife from war could sell her for money. True or false?
What did Moses say a father must give his firstborn son, even if that son's mother was the unloved wife?

answers.text: A double portion of all he has
The family house and all its land
Half of all his flocks and herds

questions.question: Moses said that if an executed man's body was hung on a tree, what must Israel do with it?

answers.text: Leave it up for three days
Keep it up until the elders say
